name: Live Event Seating Lite – Seating Chart, Floor Plan & Ticket Sales
author: macmonir

sections.description:
Sell Tickets from Your Own WordPress Site — Zero Commission, Zero Coding.

Are you paying Eventbrite or Ticketmaster a cut of every ticket sale? Tired of building seating charts in spreadsheets, then manually cross-checking bookings? Live Event Seating Lite solves both problems — for free.

It gives you a drag-and-drop venue builder and a full WooCommerce ticket sales system, directly inside WordPress. Customers pick their seat on a live interactive map, pay through your existing WooCommerce checkout, and you keep 100% of the revenue.

Works for concerts, churches, gala dinners, workshops, conferences, auditoriums, stadiums, and table-reservation events.

🎥 See It In Action (Video Tutorials)

How to Create a Seating Chart

How to Connect Seats to WooCommerce

Advanced Venue Builder Features

🆓 What You Get — Free

  • Drag & Drop Venue Builder: Build your seating chart visually inside WordPress admin — no design tools, no developers.
  • All Element Types: Circular tables, rectangular tables, seat rows, stages, images, and freeform polygon shapes.
  • WooCommerce Ticket Sales: Link seat prices to WooCommerce variable products and accept payments with any gateway you already use.
  • Multi-Level Pricing: Charge different prices for VIP, Standard, and Economy seats on the same map.
  • Interactive Seat Selection: Customers click a seat and see its price in real time before adding to cart.
  • 5-Minute Seat Locking: A seat turns “reserved” (orange) the moment it hits a cart, preventing double-bookings — and auto-releases if the order is abandoned.
  • Prevent Double-Bookings: Completed bookings mark seats gray and unavailable instantly.
  • Full Order Details: Seat number, event name, date, time, and venue appear in the WooCommerce cart, checkout, order emails, and thank-you page automatically.
  • Customizable Seat Colors: Match your brand — change available, selected, and booked colors from plugin settings.
  • Shortcode Display: Paste [lesl_seating_plan id="YOUR_EVENT_ID"] into any page or post.
  • 0% Ticket Commission: Keep every dollar your customers pay.

🚀 Hitting a Limit? Upgrade to Premium.

The free version is built for getting started. The Premium versions are built for running a professional event operation — handling sold-out waitlists, smartphone check-ins, self-service seat swaps, group bookings, and more.

👉 View All Premium Plans & Pricing

🏆 Which Version is Right For You?

LITE (Free)
Best for: Launching your first ticketed event with WooCommerce.
* Visual drag-and-drop builder
* WooCommerce seat-based ticket sales
* Multi-level pricing, seat locking, double-booking prevention
* Display via shortcode

STARTER — 1 Website
Best for: A single venue that needs a polished, professional setup.
* 0% Ticket Fees — keep 100% of every sale
* Tiered Pricing — VIP vs Standard, visually shown on the map
* Whole Table Booking — one click for a sponsor to buy an entire table
* Real-time Seat Summary — live cart sidebar prevents race-condition double-bookings
* Advanced Builder Tools — Undo/Redo (Ctrl+Z), 360° rotation, curved seat rows, block/kill seats, alphabetic seat numbering
* Pan & Zoom — mobile-friendly map navigation for large venues

BASIC — 5 Websites
Best for: Freelancers and agencies managing multiple client venues.
* Everything in Starter, licensed for up to 5 sites

PRO — Unlimited Websites
Best for: Power users, large venues, festivals, and complex multi-section spaces.
* Everything in Starter & Basic, plus:
* QR Code Ticket Scanner — check in guests at the door from any smartphone
* Sections Mode — balconies, orchestra pits, and multi-zone stadium layouts
* General Admission (GA) Areas — sell unreserved standing-room tickets
* Booking Manager — central attendee dashboard with export
* Import/Export Venue Layouts (JSON) — reuse your venue as a template
* Calendar Integration — The Events Calendar and Events Manager plugins
* Countdown Timer — seat lock timer visible in cart and checkout
* Advanced Ticket Templates — drag-and-drop PDF ticket customizer
* Seat & Table Add-ons — upsell food, drinks, and extras at checkout
* Gutenberg Blocks — add your seating map or waitlist form with no shortcode
* 🔔 Waitlist System — capture sales even after selling out ↓
* 🔁 Seat Transfer — let customers swap their own seats after purchase ↓
* 👥 Group & Bulk Booking — auto-select adjacent seats for groups ↓
* 🎟️ Per-Seat-Type Coupons — discount codes locked to specific seat tiers ↓
* 📅 Multi-Date Events — one map, multiple performances ↓
* ♿ Accessibility Seat Marking — ADA-compliant wheelchair and companion badges ↓
* 👤 Guest Name Assignment — personalized place cards and check-ins for VIP tables ↓
* 📱 Apple & Google Wallet Passes — one-tap “Add to Wallet” on thank-you page, emails & My Account ↓
* 🏷️ Manual Order Management — book any seat for walk-ins, phone orders, and comps directly from admin ↓
* Premium Support

👉 Compare All Features & Get Pro

🔔 PRO: Waitlist & Sold-Out Capture System

Stop losing revenue the moment your event sells out.

When seats are gone, interested buyers leave and book elsewhere. The Waitlist System captures every one of those missed sales automatically — no manual work required.

  • A signup form appears on your event page the moment it sells out
  • When any seat is released, the next person in the queue gets a 30-minute unique purchase link — creating urgency and driving immediate conversions
  • If the link expires unused, the system moves to the next person automatically
  • The Waitlist Manager in your admin shows every entry with name, email, status, and join date
  • Works automatically on order cancellation, refund, and failure

👉 Get the Waitlist Feature in Pro

🔁 PRO: Self-Service Seat Transfer

Eliminate seat-swap support emails entirely.

Post-purchase seat change requests are one of the most time-consuming support tasks for event organisers. The Seat Transfer system gives customers a self-service form in their WooCommerce My Account page — and gives you full one-click approval control.

  • Customers pick their current booking, search for any available seat, and submit a request
  • You approve or reject with one click — the plugin automatically updates the seating map, the WooCommerce order, and emails the customer
  • A full audit trail note is added to the order for your records

👉 Get Seat Transfer in Pro

👥 PRO: Group & Bulk Booking with Auto Seat Picker

Stop losing corporate clients and school groups to friction.

Clicking 30 individual seats one by one drives group buyers away. The Group Booking mode adds a “Find Best Seats” toolbar above your chart — just like the airline booking experience your customers already know.

  • Customer enters how many seats they need and clicks “Find Best Seats”
  • The system instantly highlights the best consecutive block of available seats
  • Respects killed seats, soft-locked seats, and already-booked seats
  • Works with theater-style rows and table layouts

👉 Get Group Booking in Pro

📅 PRO: Multi-Date Events — One Map, Every Performance

Perfect for festivals, conferences, and weekend workshops.

Build your seating plan once and attach a full multi-day schedule. When a customer books a seat, they’re reserving it for the entire event duration — one ticket, one seat, all dates.

  • Add unlimited dates per event
  • The full itinerary appears in the cart, confirmation email, and on the PDF ticket
  • Manage all attendees across all dates from one unified Booking Manager

👉 Get Multi-Date Events in Pro

♿ PRO: Wheelchair & Accessibility Seat Marking

Prevent accidental bookings of ADA seats and avoid messy refunds.

Standard ticketing systems treat every seat the same — putting dedicated accessible seats at risk of being booked by able-bodied guests.

  • Mark seats as Wheelchair or Companion directly in the map builder
  • High-visibility badges display on the live chart, cart, checkout, and PDF ticket
  • Drastically reduces accidental bookings and compliance headaches

👉 Get Accessibility Seat Marking in Pro

👤 PRO: Guest Name Assignment per Seat

Accurate place cards and personalized check-ins for galas, weddings, and VIP tables.

When a sponsor buys a table of 10, the billing name is rarely the name of the 10 people sitting there. Without individual names, printing place cards and running door check-ins becomes a logistical nightmare.

  • Attach a specific guest name to each seat after a booking is made
  • Guest names print on the PDF ticket next to their exact table and seat number
  • Export attendee lists as CSV with real human names — not just the company credit card name

👉 Get Guest Name Assignment in Pro

📱 PRO: Apple Wallet & Google Wallet Pass Integration

Modern attendees don’t print tickets. Meet them where they already are.

Customers who receive a PDF ticket either print it (and lose it) or screenshot the QR code and hope they can find it on event day. Apple Wallet and Google Wallet exist precisely to solve this — a pass lives on the lock screen, updates automatically, and surfaces the moment a customer arrives at your venue.

  • Generates a .pkpass (Apple Wallet) and Google Wallet pass automatically when an order completes
  • An “Add to Wallet” button appears on the Thank You page, in order confirmation emails, and in WooCommerce My Account
  • Every pass includes event name, date/time, venue, seat number, and the existing QR code — no duplicate setup required
  • Zero maintenance for the customer — the pass surfaces on their lock screen when they arrive at the venue

👉 Get Apple & Google Wallet Passes in Pro

🏷️ PRO: Walk-In & Offline Ticket Sales — Manual Order Management

Your box office staff shouldn’t need a separate system.

Running a live event means customers arrive in ways you can’t always predict. A walk-in at the door, a sponsor calling to book a table for ten, a VIP guest whose ticket needs to be comp’d on the spot. If your only booking tool is the public-facing checkout, every one of those situations creates a problem.

The Manual Order system gives event staff a complete, dedicated admin interface to book any seat or GA area for any customer — instantly, without touching the WooCommerce frontend at all.

  • Select any available seat or GA area directly from the live seating map inside WordPress admin
  • Assign the booking to any existing customer or create a guest entry on the spot
  • Every manual booking creates a real, first-class WooCommerce order — it appears in revenue reports, feeds into analytics, and is fully refundable like any other order
  • A scannable QR code ticket is generated immediately, with an optional branded confirmation email sent to the customer
  • Handles walk-ins, phone reservations, comp tickets, and sponsor group bookings from one interface

👉 Get Manual Order Management in Pro
sections.installation:
1. Upload the live-event-seating-lite folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Seating Charts > Add New.
  4. Use the “Seating Plan Builder” to create your chart.
  5. Copy the shortcode from the “Event Seating Settings” box.
  6. Paste the shortcode into any page or post to display your seating chart.
sections.faq:
How do I create a seating chart in WordPress?

Go to Seating Charts > Add New and use the drag-and-drop builder to place tables, seat rows, and stages on your canvas. When you’re done, copy the shortcode and paste it into any page or post.

Can I sell tickets for free without paying commission?

Yes. The free Lite version includes full WooCommerce integration — your customers select seats, pay through your existing WooCommerce checkout, and you keep 100% of the revenue. No per-ticket fees, ever.

Do I need WooCommerce?

Yes. WooCommerce (free) must be installed and active to sell tickets. The plugin maps your visual seating chart to WooCommerce products for a secure, familiar checkout.

What happens if two customers try to book the same seat at the same time?

The moment a seat is added to a cart, it is soft-locked for 5 minutes and turns (“reserved”) for all other visitors. If the order is not completed, the seat is automatically released — preventing double-bookings without any manual work.

How do I scan tickets at the door?

The Pro version includes a dedicated scanner page created automatically at installation, plus a shortcode you can place on any existing page. In the plugin settings, you choose who can access the scanner — either a specific WordPress user role (e.g. your box office staff) or the public. If set to a role, that staff member simply logs into their own WordPress profile and navigates to the scanner page — no admin access needed. If set to public, anyone with the link can scan from any device with no login required. Either way, scanning works from any smartphone browser — no app to install.

What happens when my event sells out?

With the Waitlist System in Pro, a signup form appears automatically. When any seat is released, the next person in the queue receives a 30-minute purchase link — all without any manual effort from you.

Can customers change their seat after booking?

Yes — with Seat Transfer in Pro. Customers submit a swap request from My Account. You approve or reject with one click, and the plugin handles everything else automatically.

Can I book multiple adjacent seats at once for a group?

Yes — with Group Booking in Pro. A “Find Best Seats” toolbar lets customers enter how many seats they need and the system instantly finds and highlights the best available consecutive block.

Does this work with The Events Calendar?

Yes. Pro includes native integration with The Events Calendar and Events Manager plugins.

Can I use one seating map for a multi-day event?

Yes — with Multi-Date Events in Pro. Attach a full schedule to a single map. One ticket covers the entire event run, with the full itinerary shown on every PDF ticket.

Can I mark seats for wheelchair access?

Yes — with Accessibility Seat Marking in Pro. Designate seats as Wheelchair or Companion, with visual badges on the live map and throughout the entire checkout process.

Can I assign guest names to individual seats for a gala or wedding?

Yes — with Guest Name Assignment in Pro. Attach a specific attendee name to any seat after purchase, so your place cards and CSV exports show real names, not billing names.

Can customers save their ticket to Apple Wallet or Google Wallet?

Yes — with Wallet Pass Integration in Pro. When an order completes, an “Add to Wallet” button appears on the Thank You page, in the confirmation email, and in My Account. The pass includes the event details, seat info, and QR code, and updates automatically if a seat transfer is approved.

Can I book seats manually for walk-ins or phone orders without going through the public checkout?

Yes — with Manual Order Management in Pro. Event staff can select any available seat from the live map inside WordPress admin, assign it to a customer, and generate a real WooCommerce order with a scannable QR ticket and optional confirmation email — all without touching the public-facing checkout.
sections.changelog:
1.2.2

  • Fix: added settings for the seat colors which can be controlled from admin
  • Fix: Seat lock race condition resolved — the same seat can no longer be soft-locked by two customers simultaneously during concurrent bookings
  • Fix: Multiple seats now add correctly to cart — each seat gets its own unique cart entry instead of merging into one
  • Fix: Seat info now displays correctly in WooCommerce Gutenberg Cart and Checkout blocks
  • Fix: Order details on thank-you page, My Account, and emails now show seat info in clean format (Event title, seat label, date/time/venue) instead of raw meta keys
  • Fix: PHP warning “Undefined variable $has_seat” on cart page removed
  • Fix: Quantity number no longer shown next to seat items on thank-you page
